First release of TaskForge for Android. It uses the same API and accounts as the [web app](https://taskforge-app-869.netlify.app), so your organizations, projects and boards are already there when you sign in.

## Download

Most phones need `TaskForge-1.0.0-arm64-v8a.apk`. If you are not sure which one fits, take `TaskForge-1.0.0-universal.apk`, which runs on every device but is larger. The `.aab` file is for uploading to Google Play.

These builds are signed with a debug key, so Android will ask you to allow installs from your browser or file manager the first time.

## Demo account

Sign in with `admin@taskforge.dev` and the password `TaskForge2024!`, or tap "Use demo account" on the login screen. The demo organization has a project with 150 tasks, so the charts, timeline and activity feed have data to show. The API runs on Render's free tier, and the first request after a quiet spell can take about 50 seconds.

## What's in it

- Sign in, register and stay signed in. Expired sessions refresh in the background.
- A home dashboard with an organization switcher, stats and your recent projects.
- Organization pages for members, roles, invitations and settings.
- A projects list you can search, filter and sort, with create, edit, archive and delete.
- Project boards with Board, Overview, Timeline and Activity tabs. Long-press a card to drag it to another column, or use "Move to". The board updates live when teammates make changes.
- Task detail with status, priority, assignees, labels, dates, progress, description, subtasks, comments, activity history and attachments.
- An inbox for notifications. Swipe one to mark it read.
- Profile editing, password changes, and the billing and pricing pages.

## Known limits

Uploading attachments and importing projects still need the web app. There is no iOS download yet; CI builds iOS without code signing to check that it compiles.
